name: Electricity, PPA and capacity prices faced by data centres
description: PPA values are labelled by source as analyst estimate, derived arithmetic or disclosed notional value. Behind-the-meter and grid prices are kept side by side; analyst premiums are quoted, not recomputed.

capex.metric: behind-the-meter gas generation for data centres
capex.basis: RaboResearch estimate depending on overbuild assumptions, bridge duration and gas price; versus $90-95/MWh grid alternatives
Nodus Partners analyst note; grid supply $90-95/MWh; a $40/MWh premium on a 25 MW facility is stated as about $8.8m/year

capex.metric: Microsoft / Constellation Crane PPA implied price
capex.basis: Analyst estimates reported by Open Factory: Jefferies ~$112/MWh, Bloomberg Intelligence $100/MWh, Morgan Stanley and Jefferies range $98-115; underlying deal price not disclosed

capex.metric: Amazon / Talen Susquehanna PPA implied flat-equivalent price
capex.basis: Open Factory arithmetic on disclosed ~$18bn notional over 17 years at 94.6% capacity factor; $82 high ramp, $94 low ramp; contract covers energy and capacity

capex.metric: Meta / Constellation Clinton PPA implied price
capex.basis: Jefferies estimate reported by Open Factory; virtual PPA for clean energy attributes, 1,121 MW, 20 years from June 2027

capex.metric: Pennsylvania average industrial retail price, September 2025
capex.basis: EIA-861M as compiled by Open Factory; delivered price including distribution, transmission and capacity

capex.metric: Texas average industrial retail price, September 2025
capex.basis: EIA-861M as compiled by Open Factory
EIA STEO December 2025 as compiled by Open Factory; PJM West 2024 $40.75, 2026 forecast $63.69

capex.metric: PJM capacity auction clearing price, 2027/28 delivery year
capex.basis: December 2025 auction; cap reached; auction short by 6,623 MW; two years earlier the same auction cleared at $28.92/MW-day

capex.metric: five-year bridge power cost, 100 MW site
capex.basis: Open Factory modelled range at 85% utilisation and $3.78/MMBtu gas: $96/MWh solid oxide fuel cells, $104.20 gas reciprocating engines, $112 aeroderivative turbines; model output, not a contract price

sources.note: PPA values are labelled by source as analyst estimate, derived arithmetic or dis

gaps.what: Contract price for Microsoft/Crane, Meta/Clinton, Vistra/Comanche Peak and Google/Duane Arnold PPAs
gaps.why: Parties did not disclose price; all figures in the record are analyst estimates or arithmetic
gaps.next_action: Monitor FERC Form 1, SEC 10-K/10-Q and state PUC filings for price disclosure

notes: From the 10-year data-centre power retrospective (Power costs and contracts). Evidence-first 2016-2026 retrospective of data-centre power cost and contract evidence. Primary regulatory material includes the Texas PUC McCloud/Meta filing:
